messages:
Maya G.: FYI customer reported that their promo credits vanished during an org transfer / SSO migration. account: acct_9b4f, promo code: NEWYEAR24. they did a big test and now are blocked. can we look?
Evan B.: Pinged to grab the billing logs. do we have the transfer audit id?
Maya G.: transfer webhook id: tx_2026_03_15_72, migration started 2026-03-15T18:02Z. Customer says credits were visible pre-transfer and gone after.
Harper L.: Seen this before when stripe-hook retry failed and credits expired on schedule. can you confirm trial expiry timestamp?
Maya G.: trial_expiry: 2026-03-16T04:00Z (UTC). They attempted the transfer at 18:02Z previous day. So credits should still have been active.
Evan B.: Pulling events: payment-service shows promo_applied event for acct_9b4f at 2026-02-16T10:12Z, promo_revoked at 2026-03-16T04:00Z as expected. I see a webhook_error for org transfer at 2026-03-15T18:03Z with 504 timeout.
Harper L.: Hmm if webhook timed out, the control-plane state may not have recorded the transfer and TTL cleanup could have removed ephemeral credits. do we have the console log for the transfer flow?
Maya G.: Uploaded snippet from customer: "I clicked 'transfer org', saw a spinner, then SSO redirected back. When I logged back in credits missing."
Jin (support-ops): Looking at backend: there was a failed background job retry that marked provisional credits as expired because it couldn't find org_owner during reconcile. job_id: jb_88f3.
Evan B.: So root cause: race between migration reconcile job and TTL-based expiration. Policy-wise credits expired per TTL but customer lost access mid-migration. We need an exception.
Maya G.: Customer wants reinstatement of remaining promo balance (they used ~12% of credits). asking for full restore.
Harper L.: We should follow standard playbook: 1) verify unused token count, 2) check fraud/payment flags, 3) manual grant if low risk. I'll do counts and fraud check.
Evan B.: Fraud/policy: account passes checks. unused_tokens_estimate: ~88.
Jin (support-ops): I'll prepare a manual grant and note reason "migration race-condition, webhook timeout". What amount? match original remaining credits: 88 tokens equivalent to promo id NEWYEAR24_remaining.
Maya G.: Customer also asked about future prevention + policy. they want a timeline for fix and whether transfer steps will preserve credits.
Harper L.: Proposed customer response: "We can reinstate the remaining promo tokens now. Our engineering team will patch the migration reconcile to defer TTL cleanup for in-progress transfers and add a retry/backoff to the webhook. ETA for fix: 2 weeks. We'll follow up with an incident note and a small goodwill credit for the disruption." Thoughts?
Evan B.: Fine. Approve manual grant. Also add a short-lived monitoring alert for webhook 5xx spikes.
Jin (support-ops): Grant prepared: promo_manual_grant_19678, amount: 88 tokens applied at 2026-03-17T14:20Z. Logged in case notes and CC'd billing.
Maya G.: I'll message the customer: "We've restored your remaining promo balance and apologize — engineering will patch the migration flow to avoid this race. We'll keep you updated and add a small goodwill credit for the inconvenience"
Harper L.: Recommend followup: 1) postmortem entry, 2) add unit/integration test for transfer + TTL, 3) deploy webhook retry/backoff. I'll file a short ticket and tag eng-platform.
Evan B.: Ticket: PLAT-3942 created. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maya G.: Thanks team. I'll close with the customer once they confirm they see credits. :sparkles:
